title: Canonical Registry

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI identifying the schema this canonical registry conforms to.

registry_version.description: Semantic version of the canonical registry format.

entries.description: Array of canonical registry entries defining the shared vocabulary.

aliases.description: Array of alias mappings that resolve alternative names to canonical entry IDs.

canonicalId.description: Fully qualified canonical identifier in the format cn:<namespace>:<kind>:<slug>.

semver.description: Semantic version string in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format.

owner.description: Lowercase identifier for a team or role responsible for a canonical entry.

entryStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a canonical entry: active (in use), deprecated (discouraged), sunset (removal scheduled), or retired (removed).

introduced_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this canonical entry was first added to the registry.

deprecated_since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this entry was marked as deprecated.

sunset_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which this entry will be retired.

retired_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this entry was fully retired and removed from active use.

replaced_by.description: Canonical ID of the entry that supersedes this deprecated or retired entry.

deprecation_note.description: Human-readable explanation of why this entry was deprecated and what to use instead.

source_field.description: JSON path in the source spec artifact where this entry was proposed (e.g., 'terms[*].term', 'capabilities[*].capability_ref'). Written by canon-accept for provenance tracking.

accepted_from.description: Path to the spec file this entry was accepted from. Written by canon-accept for provenance tracking.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle timestamps tracking the progression of a canonical entry through active, deprecated, sunset, and retired states.

deprecated_since.description: ISO 8601 date when this alias was deprecated.

sunset_date.description: ISO 8601 date after which this alias will no longer resolve.

replaced_by.description: Canonical ID that this deprecated alias should be replaced with.

aliasLifecycle.description: Lifecycle metadata for a deprecated alias, tracking deprecation and sunset dates.

id.description: Fully qualified canonical ID for this entry (cn:<namespace>:<kind>:<slug>).

kind.description: Category of this canonical entry (e.g., unit, stage, environment, role).

preferred_label.description: Human-readable display name for this canonical term.

definition.description: Clear definition of what this canonical term represents in the spec pipeline.

version.description: Semantic version of this individual canonical entry.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this entry (active, deprecated, sunset, or retired).

items.description: An owner identifier for this canonical entry.

owners.description: Array of team or role identifiers responsible for maintaining this canonical entry.

items.description: A constraint string limiting how this canonical term may be used.

constraints.description: Optional array of constraint strings that limit how this canonical term may be used.

items.description: An example usage string demonstrating this canonical term.

examples.description: Optional array of example usage strings demonstrating this canonical term in context.

items.description: A classification tag for this canonical entry.

tags.description: Optional array of classification tags for filtering and grouping canonical entries.

items.description: An alternative name that resolves to this canonical entry.

aliases.description: Optional array of alternative names that resolve to this canonical entry.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle timestamps for this entry, tracking introduction, deprecation, sunset, and retirement.

entry.description: A single canonical registry entry defining a shared vocabulary term with lifecycle management.

aliasStatus.description: Status of a canonical alias: active (resolves normally) or deprecated (still resolves but discouraged).

kind.description: Canonical kind category this alias belongs to (must match the target entry kind).

normalized.description: Normalized form of the alias string used for matching during resolution.

target_id.description: Fully qualified canonical ID that this alias resolves to.

status.description: Whether this alias is active or deprecated.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle metadata for deprecated aliases, including deprecation date and replacement.

alias.description: An alias mapping that resolves an alternative name to a canonical entry ID.

description: Schema for the canonical registry defining shared vocabulary terms with lifecycle management.
